title: Geographic origin, destination, and physical envelope
description: Origin and destination geohashes for an order with physical handoff, plus the shipment's physical envelope (mass, volume) and class of service. Extends v1 by promoting mass/volume/class from optional metadata to first-class validated fields. Every field is required when this clause is included.

fields.name: originGeohash
fields.description: Origin geohash (base32). 1–12 characters; longer = higher precision.

fields.name: destinationGeohash
fields.description: Destination geohash (base32). 1–12 characters; longer = higher precision.

fields.name: massGrams
fields.description: Shipment mass in whole grams. Must be at least 1 g; capped at uint32 max (≈4.29 million kg).

fields.name: volumeMl
fields.description: Shipment volume in whole millilitres. Must be at least 1 ml; capped at uint32 max (≈4.29 million L).

fields.name: classOfService
fields.description: Class of service. S = Standard (room temperature, not fragile). E = Express (priority window). F = Fragile (handle with care). C = Cold Chain (refrigerated transport required).
